name: caep.dev
summary: Public test Transmitter and Receiver for trying CAEP events against your own implementation.

name: shared-signals.dev playground
summary: This site’s public sample Transmitter and Receiver, built to the CAEP Interoperability Profile: OAuth-protected stream management, push and poll delivery, every CAEP and RISC event, and a Receiver and SET inspector that check each SET against the specs.

name: Identity Security Cloud
summary: Receives session-revoked, credential-change, token-claims-change, device-compliance-change and risk-level-change events and acts on them with Workflows; transmits session-revoked when an identity's lifecycle state changes.

name: Identity Threat Protection
summary: Receives CAEP and RISC signals from security vendors and feeds them into entity risk policy (session revocation, Universal Logout, Workflows); transmits session-revoked and credential-change.

name: CAEP Hub
summary: SGNL’s access-management platform (now part of CrowdStrike) as both SSF Transmitter and Receiver; ingests CAEP events as a real-time system of record for access decisions.

name: Google Workspace Shared Signals (closed beta)
summary: SSF integration for Google Workspace. Interop results: Receiver by poll (Dec 2024), Transmitter by push against the final specs (Oct 2025).

name: Cross-Account Protection (RISC)
summary: Google sends RISC security events about Google Accounts to apps that use Sign in with Google.

name: Verify Antenna
summary: A lightweight, self-hosted container for IBM Verify that exchanges security events and risk signals using SSF.

name: Cisco (Duo)
summary: Cisco demonstrated push Transmitter and Receiver interop (SGNL's write-up names Cisco Duo). Cisco also runs sharedsignals.guide, a developer guide to SSF.

name: Jamf Security Cloud
summary: Transmits device-compliance-change and risk events for managed Apple devices; documented integrations with Okta and SailPoint.

name: Omnissa
summary: Push Transmitter in OIDF interop results. No public SSF documentation found yet; link goes to the interop results.

name: Thales
summary: Push Receiver in OIDF interop results. No public SSF product documentation found yet; link goes to the interop results.

name: AppOmni
summary: SaaS security; push Transmitter in OIDF interop results. No public SSF documentation found yet; link goes to the interop results.

name: Saviynt
summary: Identity governance; poll Receiver in OIDF interop results. No public SSF documentation found yet; link goes to the interop results.

name: Delinea
summary: Privileged access; Transmitter and Receiver in OIDF interop results. No public SSF documentation found yet; link goes to the interop results.

name: WinMagic
summary: Endpoint authentication; Transmitter (push and poll) and push Receiver in OIDF interop results. No public SSF documentation found yet; link goes to the interop results.

name: VeriClouds
summary: Compromised-credential intelligence; has demonstrated an SSF Transmitter for the RISC credential-compromise event. VeriClouds contributed to the RISC specification.

name: Helisoft
summary: Transmitted CAEP events to SGNL at the first interop event. No public SSF documentation found yet; link goes to the OpenID Foundation’s report, which lists Helisoft.

name: secevent
summary: Build, sign, parse and validate Security Event Tokens (RFC 8417).

name: ssfreceiver
summary: Library for building SSF Receivers: discovery, stream management and event handling.

name: SSF Receiver for Go
summary: A Go Shared Signals Receiver supporting push and poll delivery, stream status, and typed CAEP events.
